title: 健康的小吃店取代不健康的习惯
desc: 健康的小吃店取代不健康的习惯

paragraphs.en: According to the National Center for Health Statistics of the United States, roughly 37 percent of US adults consume fast food on a daily basis.
paragraphs.zh: 根据美国国家卫生统计中心的数据，大约37%的美国成年人每天都会食用快餐。

paragraphs.en: The center found a significant rise in the number of severe obesity cases in very young children aged 2 to 5.
paragraphs.zh: 该中心发现，2至5岁幼儿的严重肥胖病例数量显著增加。

paragraphs.en: Thank you so much for having us here in your home.
paragraphs.zh: 非常感谢您邀请我们到您家做客。

paragraphs.en: Zobaida Falah, an Ohio-based Muslim entrepreneur, launched her snack bar company called Cure in June 2016
paragraphs.zh: 佐拜达·法拉赫是一位来自俄亥俄州的穆斯林企业家，她于2016年6月创办了一家名为“Cure”的小吃店，

paragraphs.en: in an effort to end unhealthy food habits and raise awareness about proper nutrition and its benefits.
paragraphs.zh: 旨在消除不健康的饮食习惯，并提高人们对合理营养及其益处的认识。

paragraphs.en: To fight obesity and junk food habits, Falah created a line of organic healthy bars for all. The idea come to her when she was teaching math and English to kids.
paragraphs.zh: 为了对抗肥胖和垃圾食品习惯，法拉赫为所有人推出了一系列有机健康棒，她教孩子们英语和数学时，有了这个主意。

paragraphs.en: I would watch my students to come into the classroom, eating chips and soda, refined sugars, bad carbs.
paragraphs.zh: 我看着我的学生们走进教室，吃着薯片、喝着汽水，里面含有精制糖和不健康的碳水化合物。

paragraphs.en: And anytime I asked them why do you guys eat so poorly, a very common response was healthy food just doesn't taste good.
paragraphs.zh: 每当我问他们为什么吃得这么不健康时，一个非常常见的回答是健康食品就是不好吃。

paragraphs.en: With taste in her mind, Falah started experimenting on a unique recipe inspired by her grandmother.
paragraphs.zh: 法拉赫脑海中想着那种味道，开始尝试一种受她祖母启发的独特食谱。

paragraphs.en: Ingredients include a mixture of nuts, flavorful seeds, honey and black seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 配料包括坚果混合物、风味种子、蜂蜜和黑籽。

paragraphs.en: It took off. But to this day she still runs her business from home, meeting roughly four to six thousand orders a month.
paragraphs.zh: 直到今天她仍然在家经营业务，每月大约处理四千到六千份订单。

paragraphs.en: Falah doesn't just want to change people's health but also tackle hunger as she donates a snack bar to the homeless for ages when sold.
paragraphs.zh: 法拉赫不仅想改变人们的健康状况，还想解决饥饿问题，因为她每卖出一份零食棒，就会长期为无家可归者捐赠一份。

paragraphs.en: We have a social movement and mission behind the company, which means that when we first launched we would donate a bar for every bar that we sold and we would donate it to people experiencing homelessness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们公司背负社会运动和使命，这意味着我们刚推出产品时，每售出一份产品就会捐赠一份给无家可归的人。

paragraphs.en: And as the company has grown and we've expanded and added new product lines to our brand.
paragraphs.zh: 随着公司的发展壮大，我们扩大了业务范围并为品牌新增了多条产品线。

paragraphs.en: Now we actually donate a percentage of all of our profits towards alleviating world hunger.
paragraphs.zh: 现在，我们实际上会将所有利润的一定比例捐赠出去，用于缓解世界饥饿问题。

paragraphs.en: Falah says her company has helped more than 200,000 poor people in the U.S. and abroad, including refugees in Syria, Morocco, Palestine, and Gambia.
paragraphs.zh: 法拉赫说，她的公司已经帮助了美国和国外超过20万人，包括叙利亚、摩洛哥、巴勒斯坦和冈比亚的难民。
